# Which regexes in your code can hang your server?

> A free static ReDoS scanner for JS, TS and Python with a CI-ready CLI and an optional timing probe. No account, no upload.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## How it checks

Shape rules for known ReDoS patterns, plus an exact automaton check that finds a word a pattern can read two ways inside a loop and gives the attack string (prefix + pump repeated + a failing character). On 6,000 random patterns timed in V8 it caught every exponential one; method and limits in eval/README.md.
